import sys
from collections import deque

class Coord:
    def __init__(self, r=0, c=0):
        self.r = r
        self.c = c

dr = [-1, 0, 0, 1]
dc = [0, -1, 1, 0]

sizeN, maxT = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
mazeA = [['#'] * (sizeN + 2) for _ in range(sizeN + 2)]
mazeB = [['#'] * (sizeN + 2) for _ in range(sizeN + 2)]
maze = [['#'] * (sizeN + 2) for _ in range(sizeN + 2)]
distA = [[-1] * (sizeN + 2) for _ in range(sizeN + 2)]
distB = [[-1] * (sizeN + 2) for _ in range(sizeN + 2)]

scientists = []
capsules = []
z = Coord()

for r in range(1, sizeN + 1):
    lineA = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip()
    for c in range(1, sizeN + 1):
        mazeA[r][c] = lineA[c - 1]
for r in range(1, sizeN + 1):
    lineB = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip()
    for c in range(1, sizeN + 1):
        mazeB[r][c] = lineB[c - 1]

for r in range(1, sizeN + 1):
    for c in range(1, sizeN + 1):
        if mazeA[r][c].isdigit():
            if mazeA[r][c] > '0':
                scientists.append(Coord(r, c))
            maze[r][c] = '.'
        elif mazeA[r][c] == 'Z':
            z = Coord(r, c)
            maze[r][c] = '.'
        if mazeB[r][c].isdigit() and mazeB[r][c] > '0':
            capsules.append(Coord(r, c))

def computeDistA(start):
    for i in range(sizeN + 2):
        for j in range(sizeN + 2):
            distA[i][j] = -1
    distA[start.r][start.c] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append(start)
    while q:
        p = q.popleft()
        for k in range(4):
            nr = p.r + dr[k]
            nc = p.c + dc[k]
            if maze[nr][nc] != '.':
                continue
            if distA[nr][nc] < 0:
                distA[nr][nc] = distA[p.r][p.c] + 1
                q.append(Coord(nr, nc))

def computeDistB(start):
    for i in range(sizeN + 2):
        for j in range(sizeN + 2):
            distB[i][j] = -1
    distB[start.r][start.c] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append(start)
    while q:
        p = q.popleft()
        if distA[p.r][p.c] >= 0 and distB[p.r][p.c] >= distA[p.r][p.c]:
            continue
        for k in range(4):
            nr = p.r + dr[k]
            nc = p.c + dc[k]
            if maze[nr][nc] != '.':
                continue
            if distB[nr][nc] < 0:
                if distA[nr][nc] >= 0 and distA[nr][nc] < distB[p.r][p.c] + 1:
                    continue
                distB[nr][nc] = distB[p.r][p.c] + 1
                q.append(Coord(nr, nc))

class FlowNetwork:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.n = size
        self.capacity = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        self.flow = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        self.parent = [-1] * size
        self.level = [-1] * size

    def addEdge(self, u, v, c):
        self.capacity[u][v] += c

    def bfs(self, s, t, path):
        for i in range(self.n):
            self.parent[i] = -1
            self.level[i] = -1
        self.level[s] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if u == t:
                minCap = float('inf')
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    u2 = self.parent[v]
                    minCap = min(minCap, self.capacity[u2][v] - self.flow[u2][v])
                    v = u2
                path.clear()
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    path.append(v)
                    v = self.parent[v]
                path.append(s)
                path.reverse()
                return minCap
            for v in range(self.n):
                if self.parent[v] < 0 and self.capacity[u][v] - self.flow[u][v] > 0:
                    self.parent[v] = u
                    self.level[v] = self.level[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)
        return 0

    def maxFlow(self, s, t):
        totalFlow = 0
        p = []
        while True:
            push = self.bfs(s, t, p)
            if push == 0:
                break
            for i in range(len(p) - 1):
                u = p[i]
                v = p[i + 1]
                self.flow[u][v] += push
                self.flow[v][u] -= push
            totalFlow += push
        return totalFlow

computeDistA(z)
s = 0
t = len(scientists) + len(capsules) + 1
fn = FlowNetwork(t + 1)

for i, sc in enumerate(scientists):
    fn.addEdge(s, i + 1, int(mazeA[sc.r][sc.c]))

for j, cap in enumerate(capsules):
    fn.addEdge(len(scientists) + j + 1, t, int(mazeB[cap.r][cap.c]))

for i, sc in enumerate(scientists):
    computeDistB(sc)
    for j, cap in enumerate(capsules):
        if distB[cap.r][cap.c] >= 0 and distB[cap.r][cap.c] <= maxT:
            fn.addEdge(i + 1, len(scientists) + j + 1, float('inf'))

answer = fn.maxFlow(s, t)
print(answer)
